newsitem.title: USA: Versa to consolidate Moxness business.
newsitem.headline: Versa to consolidate Moxness business.

text.p: Versa Technologies Inc said Thursday it will shift production from the Moxness Products plant in Wausau, Wisconsin, to two other plants in Wisonconsin, affecting about 58 employees.
The affected employees will be offered jobs in other plants, Versa said.
The move is part of a plan to consolidate the operations of its industrial silicone business, Versa said.
The move might trim one or two cents from fiscal year 1998 earnings, but the company said it did not anticipate a specific quarterly charge, the company said.

"In spite of efforts to increase sales, Moxness has been unable to bring in the business needed to fill available manufacturing capacity which has resulted in a need to reduce fixed costs," James Mohrhauser, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a news release. "This consolidation, along with other cost reductions, is expected to have a favorable effect on corporate earnings in fiscal 1999."
Versa shares were unchanged at 17-1/4 Thursday.
